name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.15.0 — /git:commit step 3 reads the script's pick, passes --primary for the diagnosed file, and records the stage:fix row when escape-row refuses a duplicate. 1.14.0 — /git:merge Step 3 honours policy.mergeStrategy. 1.13.0 — The merge command now derives its merge strategy from merge-back inspect and offers it as the recommended default in one question, rather than stopping to ask for a strategy with no guidance.
